observations_and_findings.mechanism: u64::MAX as binary64 rounds to 2^64. For exactly representable kilograms 4,722,366,482,869,645/256, exact scaling by one million gives 2^64−834.75 mg, but the nearest binary64 result is 2^64. The greater-than bound does not reject equality, and the float-to-u64 cast saturates at MAX. Exact nearest integer would be 2^64−835, 834 mg below that result, under ordinary IEEE round-to-nearest multiplication.
observations_and_findings.conditions_and_limits: Pure integer mathematical analysis of an extreme value, not a product run or a claim the mathematically exact input exceeds u64. Supported producer ranges, desired large-mass conversion policy and precise accepted numerical error budget remain unproved. PL13-179 separately notes f32 component and microliter upper bounds; no equivalent concrete f32 witness is claimed.
observations_and_findings.future_direction: Decide representable range and rounding/error semantics at each physical-unit admission owner; trace actual producer caps before severity or duplicate/alias decisions.
